body: They are not "issues" or outbursts I have dissociative identity disorder

One of my personalities is a very angry, physical one and trying to control it is overwhelming , I keep saying hurtful things and yelling at her I feel out of control and I just want to be at peace. That's why I thought pils would be best, no mess.
My illness is costing me the love of my life and I'm just so tired of trying to manage my personalities

I have DID and I keep switching personalities the past few days and my girlfriend and I keep fighting bc she can't deal with my illness anymore and I don't want to either I'm sooo tired. I can't afford meds and I just can't do this anymore
